item: no test renames configs/; the remembered-drive sweep never outlives its test
summary: test_config loads no YAML through a fixture instead of renaming the checkout's configs/ (an xdist neighbour imported stopwords in that window); the row 167 guard now also catches a rename-and-restore via the folder's inode and change time (POSIX); an autouse fixture joins oo-backup-remembered-sweep at teardown.
